# thundercompute_gpu_availability (Data Source)

Retrieves current GPU availability status for all Thunder Compute configurations. Each canonical key matches the spec keys from the thundercompute_gpu_specs data source (for example "h100_x1"). Values are "available" or "unavailable".

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thundercompute_gpu_availability" "current" {}

output "gpu_availability" {
  value = data.thundercompute_gpu_availability.current.specs
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `specs` (Map of String) Map of spec configuration key to availability status ("available" or "unavailable").
